notes.title: EARLY ACCESS BUILD UPDATE 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Hey there! 🎄 Great news this Christmas!

We’ve dropped a new patch for our early access build—read the detail here! 🎉

[h2]Patch Notes : 0.1.1[/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Gale's dialogue bar would disappear during the Prologue ending (Part 4, right after the Bloody Belly Boss Battle).
[*] Added autosave points at critical moments in the Prologue to prevent loss of progression after crashes. Autosaves have been added during transitions between gameplay modes [b](Battle (Prologue Part 1) → Exploration (Flashback) → Battle (Prologue Part 2) → Exploration (Dream Sequence))[/b].
[*] Fixed a potential game freeze caused by faulty code in the Pause Menu.
[*] Food sometimes may dropped when executing a successful Heat Meter/QTE Ultimate.
[*] Added an autosave after the Result Screen.
[*] Resolved issues with controller stick navigation that cause erratic behavior in some UI menus.
[*] Fixed a bug that could freeze or crash the game when the player hold the Shield during the first Combat Tutorial.
[*] Fixed EXP Points from stages that previously cannot be saved.
[*] Fixed the Hour/Minute/Second format on the load screen menu that are only displaying 12.00.00 AM.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Renamed some settings information to avoid misinformation.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the Heat Meter's decay rate to improve gameplay flow.
[*] Lowered Medal Score calculations and thresholds, resulting in reduced prize money.[i] (Note: If you received a large amount of money before this update, consider it a gift! 😊)[/i]
[*] Simplified the first Combat Tutorial for a smoother introduction.
[*] Increased the range of dodges.
[/list]
[h3]Contents[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can enable Unlimited Skill and Ultimate points on Training Area.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enabled[b] Steam Cloud[/b] Saves for the game. 
[*] Adjusted the naming conventions for the game's save folders.
[/list]
Because we are adding Steam Cloud and changing the save directory, you may lose your data. If this happens, please follow these steps:
[olist]
[*] Go to the game save folder and copy all files, including the folder. The save files are located at: [b]\Users\user\AppData\LocalLow\extralife2\_TRIALSOFFAITH[/b]
[*] Paste the old save data into the new location. The new save files are located at: [b]\Users\user\AppData\LocalLow\Extra Life Entertainment\StellaGale[/b]
[*] That’s it! Now you can play the game with your previous save files.
[/olist]

Stay tuned for an even[b] bigger update coming soon[/b], and [b]Merry Christmas![/b] 🎅✨
